processingReceipt.method: Forward/backward LK on stable surface rim; robust partial-affine projection of original printed texture.
processingReceipt.scope: Only a printed merchandise surface; no new person is removed or covered.

decision.observation: Viewed all 240 corrected full-scene frames in eight complete sheets, temporal overview, all twenty detector crops, all 240 corrected badge-detail frames, original full-source plush-detail frames and both native endpoints; compared original S20-v2 scene and original-pixel badge comparison. One continuous native ten-second slow pullback reveals the ordinary overcast mountain lake around the same inert female-character plush and black bag. No cut, added person, real face, reflection, text or character animation. The badge uses its same original open-eye first-frame texture projected onto its own tracked surface for all 240 frames; it does not use a different expression, a later interval or two stitched shots. Gold glasses, paired violet eyes and face layout stay coherent at available native size. The tiny final badge loses fine detail through real minification; no claim of pixel-identical high-detail restoration. No visible patch halo, separation or floating edge. All raw, rejected and corrected versions preserved; source-only approval, not final-film or 2K approval.
